name: 16 zone MFP fire panel expandable to 28
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: 16 zone MFP fire panel Expandable to 28 – (Batteries not included).
features: Sixteen Zone Conventional fire panel Expandable to 28. Sixteen conventional Zone circuit which can be expanded to 28 zone by adding the plug-in boards FF501Z.
Robust metal enclosure c/w lift off lid & heavy-duty base connections.
Separate indicators for open circuit, short circuit, head-out, sounder & battery/power supply faults.
Non-latching class change sounder input, latching fire & non-latching fault outputs (via expansion loom).
Zone selectable short circuit=fire facility (no resistors in call points).
Up to 8 two-wire Repeaters per Main panel.
Compatible with virtually all known conventional fire detectors.
